panels.title: Total Incoming Requests by Method Counter

panels.description:
This chart shows the average response time for API requests, grouped by endpoint.

- The average is calculated by dividing the total time spent serving requests by the total number of requests for each base URL, over the selected time range.
- Use this chart to identify which API endpoints are slower on average and may need optimization.

panels.title: Average API Response Time by Endpoint

panels.description:
This chart displays the response time percentiles (P50, P90, P95, P99) for API requests.
- P50 (Median): 50% of requests are faster than this value (typical user experience).
- P90: 90% of requests are faster than this value (shows "tail" latency).
- P95: 95% of requests are faster than this value (captures more outliers).
- P99: 99% of requests are faster than this value (shows rare, slowest requests).

targets.expr:
histogram_quantile(
  0.95,
  sum by (endpoint_group, method, le) (
    label_replace(
      rate(cognigy_service_testing_api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", container="service-testing", exported_endpoint=~"^/simulations/[^/]+/batches/[^/]+/runs(?:/.*)?$"}[5m]),

  or

      rate(cognigy_service_testing_api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", container="service-testing", exported_endpoint=~"^/simulations/[^/]+/batches(?:/.*)?$"}[5m]),
      "endpoint_group", "/simulations/*/batches", "exported_endpoint", ".*"
    )
  or
    label_replace(
      rate(cognigy_service_testing_api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", container="service-testing", exported_endpoint=~"^/simulations/[^/]+/schedule$"}[5m]),
      "endpoint_group", "/simulations/*/schedule", "exported_endpoint", ".*"

  or
